newsitem.title: UK: Dorling sees four mln stg tax benefit.
newsitem.headline: Dorling sees four mln stg tax benefit.

text.p: Dorling Kindersley Holdings Plc expects a tax gain of four million stg in its current financial year as a result of a change in its accounting policy, finance director Peter Gill said on Tuesday.
Gill said there should be a "positive tax benefit to the tune of four million" stg from the change. He said this would feed through this time next year at the end of the tax year.
The publishing company has decided to expense multimedia development costs as incurred rather than to amortise them from publication over the frontlist life of titles.
Dorling has restated its 1996 pre-tax profits to 12.9 million stg from a previously published 17.4 million following the change.
But it said the earlier expensing of development costs should improve profitability from the Multimedia division in future years.
